name: Latent Diffusion Models (LDM) for 3D
definition: A model that learns a prior distribution pϕ(x) in the latent space to enable expressive latent representations, typically trained in two stages for NeRF auto-decoders.
summary: Latent Diffusion Models for 3D generate 3D scenes by performing diffusion in a compressed latent space rather than pixel space, offering superior computational efficiency and output quality compared to standard models.
